# Nymak Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

> WHO-GMP certified pharmaceutical manufacturer and Government of India recognised Star Export House, founded in 1998. Manufactures and exports IV fluids, finished formulations, medical devices & disposables, rapid diagnostic kits and vaccines/antisera to 24+ countries.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Nymak Pharma Private Limited
- Founded: 1998 by Mr. Ranjit Advani
- HQ & works: Plot No. 22, Phase 3, Port Biz Industrial Park, Kandla-Mundra Highway, Bhadreshwar, Mundra (Kutch), Gujarat, India
- Branch office: A-802, Money Plant High Street, Near BSNL Office, Jagatpur Road, SG Highway, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
- International offices: United Kingdom (Harrow), Sierra Leone (Freetown), Liberia (Paynesville)
- Certifications: WHO-GMP, ISO 13485:2016, Star Export House, Pharmexcil RCMC, IEC, GST
- Contact: +91 98252 25567 · info@nymakpharma.com

## Product segments

- IV Fluids — saline, dextrose, Ringer lactate, multi-electrolyte, mannitol, dialysis fluid and therapeutic infusions (ciprofloxacin, metronidazole, paracetamol, linezolid and more), 100 ml–1000 ml
- Finished Formulations — tablets, capsules, syrups, suspensions and injections across antimalarial, antibiotic (β-lactam, cephalosporin, quinolone, macrolide), antiretroviral, supplement, cardiovascular and chronic therapies
- Medical Devices & Disposables — IV cannulas, syringes, needles, infusion and administration sets, catheters, gauze, cotton wool, bandages, gloves
- Rapid Diagnostic Kits — malaria, HIV, HBsAg, HCV, syphilis, typhoid, dengue, chikungunya, pregnancy, H. pylori and more
- Vaccines & Antisera — snake venom antiserum and tetanus antitoxin (liquid and lyophilised)

## Export markets

24+ countries including Nigeria, Sierra Leone, Liberia, Ghana, Somalia, Kenya, DR Congo, Cameroon, Mauritania, Honduras and South Pacific island markets.
